taxonomy.note: Grindelia papposa G.L.Nesom & Y.B.Suh is a synonym of Grindelia ciliata under current Kew.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew treats Grindelia papposa as a synonym of G. ciliata. Hays project source uses old G. papposa; Williamson has a detailed G. ciliata treatment. Third exact target-zone county still needed.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Fewer than three exact target-zone counties locked.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not recycle historical synonym/variety records into the wrong current species concept.

morphology.look_here_first: Annual Spanish-gold gumweed with clasping serrate leaves, yellow rays, resin-gland-dotted but otherwise glabrous foliage, and a many-bristled pappus.
